tips.text: Test three Antivirus mods per stab instead of one at a time.
Run the Showdown solo; a group takes three or four times longer and clients often cannot see the stage hazards.
Put Immuno Shield and Instant Secure in the spare slots once you know the Antivirus; three stabs finishes a Coda.
Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the progress banks, but a Quick Correct Heartcell drop is lost.
Bring Overguard or invulnerability (Revenant, Dante, Rhino, Valkyr, Wukong, Nyx); Magnetic stage hazards strip Overguard fast, so Mesmer Skin got the most praise.
Pick Hex bounties marked with a Coda icon; hovering shows your Duet chance and the bounty adds node credit.
Do the Antivirus Bounty every reset to stockpile mods; later Codas then cost only missions.
Keep a revive in a squad Showdown; one player ran out and got 1 Heartcell instead of 10 to 15.
Wait for a roll of 52.8% or better, and stockpile Heartcells between rotations to buy it the moment it shows.
Don't fret over the element; Elemental Vice swaps it at rank 40.
Expect an hour or two per Coda; players call it the best-liked adversary grind, with the waiting as the only complaint.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing.
